area-between-y-strip.alt: The region between the parabola x = y² (left) and the line x = y + 2 (right), shaded from y = −1 to y = 2, where they meet at (1, −1) and (4, 2). One thin horizontal rectangle of thickness Δy has length right minus left, (y + 2) − y². A side panel gives the limits from y² = y + 2 and the area, the integral from −1 to 2 of [(y + 2) − y²] dy = 9/2.

area-y-sine-region.alt: The parabola x = y² opening to the right and the wavy curve x = 2 + sin 2y, which swings between x = 1 and x = 3 as y changes. The region Q between them is shaded, with the wave on the right, from their lower crossing near y = −1.08 to their upper crossing near y = 1.48.
